transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Kevin. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is the third time this month my internet has died completely. I run a business from home and every time it happens I lose a day's work and money. I'm at the end of my rope with you people.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Can I take your PIN to access the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Beatriz. So your connection has gone down completely three times this month, and it's down again now. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What lights are showing on the router right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just the power light. The internet light is off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have there been any works on the street, or anyone digging nearby?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's been a crew in the road for a few weeks, yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That fits. I can see a fault on the cable in your street, logged by the network team this morning. The repair is scheduled for today, and the estimate is by five p.m.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And it'll just happen again next week?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added your line to the repair notes so the engineer checks your connection specifically, and I've asked for a fault-free test to be run on the cable once it's repaired.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll also give you a mobile hotspot code for unlimited data on your phone until it's fixed. Has the text with the code come through?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I've got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Could you try the hotspot on your laptop and tell me if it connects?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's connected and working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So you're online through the hotspot for now and the line repair is booked for today. Is that okay for now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it'll do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Beatriz.
